notes: The supplied 'put on' is `added`: no token of this verse licenses it, ἀγάπην's English being complete and the governing imperative standing back at 3:12, already spent there (rules 5, 103). Folding it onto s006 remains defensible and is recorded in the unit note.
ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τούτοις is an adjunct rather than a prepositional predicate, so rule 62 does not put the supplied verb on the preposition.
s005 is emptied by the ASV's bare 'love' (rule 23), not by any displacing possessive; τούτοις is anarthrous and heads on 'these' (rule 17).
